title: Vegan German Krapfen with Malt Bread Crust
description: A twist on traditional German krapfen, these vegan versions feature a malty bread crust and a tasty filling.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Chop the malty bread into small pieces.
In a bowl, mix together flax eggs, apple sauce, maple syrup, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Add the chopped bread to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the dough into the preheated pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the first side is golden brown.
Flip and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
